# Chock plugins

> Blocks your coding agent's wrong moves before they land. Generated from the chock-catalog; each plugin states whether it enforces in this client or is advisory.

This repository is generated by `chock marketplace build` from
[chock-catalog](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock-catalog); hand edits are overwritten.
54 plugins are published here: 42 enforce in this client, 12 are advisory.

## Docs

- [Published plugins](PLUGINS.md): each plugin's version, its posture in this client, and how an enforcing package works
- [chock-catalog](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock-catalog): the policy sources; policy changes and policy issues go there
- [chock](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock): the framework that builds these plugins; emitter and hook-wiring issues go there
